# Athena agent adapter

AGENTS.md is the authoritative repository agent contract. Before substantive work, also read WORKSPACE.md, OPERATING_MODEL.md, WORK_COORDINATION.md, CURRENT_STATE.md and the relevant constitution/source hierarchy.

Use CONTINUE.md when asked to continue Athena work autonomously.

Do not invent architecture that has not been validated. Keep scientific changes separate from infrastructure fixes. Preserve raw evidence and provenance. Claim work before editing shared areas. Use isolated branches and the PR workflow. Stop/escalate at consequential decision, security, authority, collision or unresolved-source boundaries.

Before scarce model quota, run deterministic/local smoke tests.

ROADMAP.md is the long-horizon direction; treat it as adaptive and intentionally under-specified beyond the near horizon.
